_doc: Look of melee attacks, read only by src/render/vfx.js (no game rule reads it). 'weapons' sets the blade trail that follows the real weapon tip while a melee skill swings: tip/base are distances along the weapon (m, grip at 0, blade along +Z), life is how long a trail segment glows, minSpeed/fullSpeed (m/s of the tip) fade the trail in only while the blade is really moving, zone is the strength of the ground wedge that flashes where the hit area is (its size is the skill's range and arc), dust is the puff kicked up on contact. 'monsters' gives one look per melee attack name from data/monsters.json; 'overrides' tweaks it for one monster (type.attack). focus marks a weapon whose tip gathers a spell's cast glow (otherwise the right hand does). 'skills' gives a cartoon look per combat skill id from data/skills.json (style target: Cartoon FX, see docs/VFX-REFERENCE.md), in three beats: cast (fire light swelling at the focus for castTime), travel (a ribbon of soft fire blobs, grey cartoon smoke left along the path, ember streaks and a pool of light on the ground; rates are per second) and impact (white spiky flash, red halo and ground light, a yellow comic burst with speed lines, then a lumpy fireball that cools to grey smoke after cloudCool of its life and breaks into puffs). Sizes are metres. Fire colours come from the skill's element so element mods still recolour it; *Color keys are fixed smoke tones.
